alpha_source: market-like CONTROL: 95% SPY, the rest cash (no selection, no view)

selection.rule: hold 95% of equity in SPY, the rest cash; no view; no drift trades below the minimum order

exits: none (the control holds); the disaster stop only

stop_rule.sigma: 63-session sd of close-to-close returns on the bar-defect-screened panel (Alpaca daily bars when a name is not in the panel)
stop_rule.distance: clip(k_sigma x sigma, min_frac, max_frac) of the reference price
stop_rule.never_loosen: a replaced stop is never below the stop it replaces
stop_rule.order: GTC sell stop for the full long quantity; renewed within 7 days of its expiry
stop_rule.why: a DISASTER stop far outside noise: a control stopped by a wiggle stops being the market

worst_case.gap_note: a stop is not a floor: an overnight gap fills below it
worst_case.line: 1 x 95.00% x 10% stop = -$9,500 if every stop fills at its distance; 3-sigma day at 0.70% = -$1,986 (capped at 10% -> -$1,986 by scaling gross x1.00); sum|notional|/equity 0.95; no-stop ceiling -$95,000

kill_rule: never killed: the control is the yardstick; only the disaster stop acts
